facts.fact: Presidential Decree 263/25, published in the Diario da Republica on 10 December 2025 and in force on publication, creates the Centro Nacional de Ciberseguranca, a public institute charged with preventing, detecting, responding to and recovering from cyber incidents, and approves its statute; the statute makes CERT.ao a department of the Centre.

systems.owner: Angolan state public institute under the telecoms and IT ministry

systems.country_label: Departamento de Resposta a Emergencias Informaticas (CERT.ao)
